_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY — template for the render track to adapt to its Flamenco version. NOT tested against a live Flamenco Manager. Field names are generic placeholders; the render track must conform them to its Flamenco version before submitting any job. See EP1-STACK-SHOW-2026-10-24.md section 4.
_pre_submission_gates: Bake ALL simulations centrally (cloth, smoke, dynamics) before submission — un-baked sims diverge across workers.
Identical Blender and add-on versions on every node.
Textures/assets packed or on absolute shared paths every worker can reach.
Render and view one short test chunk before committing the full range.
notes: One job per shot. Manager splits the frame range into chunks; idle workers take the next chunk. Failed tasks retry on a different worker. Flamenco is GPLv3+ tool software run as separate Manager/Worker processes — no Flamenco code is embedded in game or show runtime by this template.
